candidate_evidence.quote: Our study will use Daratumumab, an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody, in combination with TMZ and RT in newly diagnosed GBM patients.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in combination with TMZ and RT in newly diagnosed GBM patients

role_evidence.quote: Our study will use Daratumumab, an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody, in combination with TMZ and RT in newly diagnosed GBM patients.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody (approved for multiple myeloma)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Daratumumab can collaborate with TMZ to enhance the cytotoxicity against GBM cells; therapeutic targeting of CD38 in GBM and its microenvironment

role_evidence.quote: Current therapeutic strategies include maximal safe surgical resection followed by course of Temozolomide (TMZ) and radiation therapy (RT).

coder_notes: Single-arm trial; temozolomide and radiotherapy are the standard backbone given to all patients (not a registered intervention but stated in the intervention description and brief summary). Brief summary mentions daratumumab has 'attained therapeutic CSF levels' as prior literature, not a planned measurement, so tumour_pk_planned = no.
